chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn 'Amira, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Assist us with devoutness (al-wara'), for whoever among you meets Allah, Mighty and Majestic, with devoutness, there will be for him a relief (faraj) with Allah.

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'Those who obey Allah and the Messenger are with those upon whom Allah has bestowed favor, of the prophets and the truthful and the martyrs and the righteous, and excellent are those as companions.'
Thus, from us (the Ahl al-Bayt) is the Prophet, and from us is the truthful, and the martyrs, and the righteous.

key_terms.أُولئِكَ: Those; referring to the groups mentioned in the verse
key_terms.الصَّالِحِينَ: The Righteous; those who are pious and do good deeds
key_terms.الصِّدِّيقِينَ: The Truthful; those who are extremely truthful in faith and testimony
key_terms.الْوَرَعِ: Devoutness; cautiousness in avoiding sins and doubtful matters
key_terms.فَرَجاً: Relief; a way out or deliverance from distress

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of 'al-wara' (devoutness) in Shia hadith and how does it relate to the Quranic verse 4:69?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes 'al-wara'' (spiritual caution) as the essential means to secure divine relief (faraj) in the Hereafter. He substantiates this by citing Quran 4:69, linking obedience to Allah and the Messenger with the company of the Prophets, Truthful, Martyrs, and Righteous, and then specifies that the Ahl al-Bayt are the source of these categories.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Assist us<sup>asws</sup> with the devoutness, for the one of you whom meets Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic with the devoutness, there would be for him, in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, a relief;

and that Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [4:69] And whoever obeys Allah and the Rasool, these are with those upon whom Allah has Bestowed Favours from among the Prophets and the Truthful and the Martyrs and the Righteous, and a goodly company are they!
Thus, from us<sup>asws</sup> is the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, and from us<sup>asws</sup> is the truthful, and the martyrs and the righteous ones’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf ibn ‘Amirah from abu al-Sabah al-Kanani from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘Support us by means of restraint from worldly matters; whoever of you will meet Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, with the quality of restraint from worldly matters will have enough good news from Allah.

Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, has said, “One who obeys Allah and the Messenger is a friend of the prophets, saints, martyrs and the righteous ones to whom Allah has granted His favors. They are the best friends that one can have.” [4:69]
‘Of our people are the prophets, the truthful ones, the martyrs and the virtuous people.’”
